articles.title: Royal Caribbean's Legend of the Seas Wraps First Europe Season
articles.summary: The new Icon-class ship is heading to Fort Lauderdale for its first winter in the Caribbean.
articles.recap: Legend of the Seas finished its first summer sailing seven-night Western Mediterranean cruises from Spain and Italy. It left Barcelona on October 29 on a 13-night crossing and is due at Port Everglades on November 7. Its naming ceremony is set for Veterans Day, November 11, in Fort Lauderdale. Then it starts six- to eight-night Caribbean and Bahamas cruises, all with a stop at Perfect Day at CocoCay.

articles.title: Norwegian Cruise Line Plans Big January Ad Push: 'Cruise Without Compromise'
articles.summary: NCL will launch a new campaign for the 2027 wave season.
articles.recap: Norwegian Cruise Line will roll out a new creative platform in January built around the idea of 'cruise without compromise.' CEO John Chidsey said families and groups want different things on vacation, and NCL lets everyone do their own thing while still traveling together. The campaign aims at premium families and seasoned travelers, most of whom have never cruised.

articles.title: Carnival Celebrates 'The Cat in the Hat' Movie on 23 Ships
articles.summary: Family Seuss fun at sea ahead of the film's November 6 premiere.
articles.recap: Carnival is marking the release of the new 'The Cat in the Hat' movie with themed family experiences on 23 ships in the two weeks before the November 6 premiere. The line is also adding two new experiences to its Seuss at Sea program, which celebrates 15 years with Dr. Seuss.

articles.title: Royal Princess Leaves Drydock With New Sanctuary Collection
articles.summary: Princess added its premium all-inclusive experience during a Singapore refit.
articles.recap: Royal Princess spent October 16 to 30 in drydock in Singapore. It now offers the Sanctuary Collection, with new ocean-view staterooms and access to the Sanctuary Club, a private adults-only top-deck retreat with its own pool, opening April 22, 2027. Until then, all guests 16 and older can preview the space.

articles.title: Antarctica21's Magellan Discoverer Heads to Punta Arenas for Christening
articles.summary: The new hybrid-electric polar ship will be named on November 6.
articles.recap: Antarctica21 took delivery of the 88-guest Magellan Discoverer, built over almost three years by ASENAV in Valdivia, Chile. The polar class ship is sailing to Punta Arenas for a christening on November 6, Chile's Day of the Antarctic. Its maiden voyage is set for December 15, exploring Southern Chile and Antarctica.

articles.title: Carnival Spirit Is Back in Mobile for the Winter
articles.summary: The ship returned from Alaska for a season of Caribbean, Bahamas and Florida cruises.
articles.recap: Carnival Spirit kicked off its 2026-27 season from Mobile, Alabama, with a seven-night cruise to Key West, Half Moon Cay and Celebration Key. Highlights include a 14-night Caribbean cruise on January 17, 2027. Its trip over from Seattle had a rough run, missing Cabo San Lucas after a late departure and Puntarenas because of Hurricane Trudy. Carnival Valor takes over in Mobile when Spirit returns to Alaska in April.

articles.title: Fewer Norwegian Cruises Will Include Airfare
articles.summary: NCLH is scaling back included flights to cut costs and lift revenue.
articles.recap: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings says a smaller share of guests will sail with airfare built into their fare. CEO John Chidsey called the old air program a marketing subsidy. Along with crew travel changes and promo tweaks, the company expects about $100 million in yearly benefits. Bookings already made under the old program will still sail as booked.

articles.title: Lindblad Adds Galápagos, Amazon and Egypt Trips for 2028-29
articles.summary: National Geographic-Lindblad released the second part of its 2028-29 voyages.
articles.recap: The new lineup includes eight Galápagos itineraries of 7 to 17 days on four ships, a combined Peru and Galápagos trip with Machu Picchu in 2029, and a new 15-day Costa Rica and Panama expedition. Baja California, the Amazon and Egypt are also part of the release.
